mapper.select: SELECT al.id, al.adminId, u.name AS adminName, al.action, al.targetType, al.targetId, al.`before`, al.`after`, al.createdAt FROM auditlog al LEFT JOIN user u ON al.adminId = u.id ORDER BY al.createdAt DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auditlog (id, adminId, action, targetType, targetId, `before`, `after`) VALUES (UUID(), #{adminId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{before}, #{after})
